notes.title: VINDICTA Update - Game Crash for Oculus users solved!
notes.content:

There was an issue that came up yesterday - preventing Oculus users from jumping into VINDICTA - when launched VINDICTA would crash. Thanks again to all of you who reached out to let us know. We really appreciate your patience and support. VINDICTA would not be the game it is today without you guys. Needless to say, keep the feedback coming!

You guys are awesome.

Best,
Lara Noujaim

notes.title: VINDICTA Update - Bug fix and Oculus controls update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[i]Update: Bug fix and Oculus controls update now live![/i]

We will be dropping a quick update that addresses an issue with Level 33 and changes to Oculus Touch controls.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/e0d66986a70aab393a3bc9c1ace2d07b61969184.jpg[/img]
[i]Destroy 'em bugs![/i]


[list]
[*] Bug fix: You can now move past Level 33 - bug relating to platforms has been fixed
[*] Oculus users: new controls have been implemented - press grip button to pick up item and let go of grip button to drop item (or drop over holster to holster the gun)
[/list]

As always, your feedback is really valuable to us as it helps us improve the game performance and continue building on the game until we get out of Early Access!

Be sure to check out our official VINDICTA discord channel https://discord.gg/yHcHMyB where you can chat with the developers and submit your feature request, bug reporting and any other random thing you have in mind! 

Thanks!
VINDICTA developers

notes.title: VINDICTA for Oculus Rift arrives on SteamVR!
notes.content:
Hello!

Excited to announce the launch of VINDICTA's Oculus Rift edition on SteamVR!

Best,
Lara and the Game Cooks Team

notes.title: VINDICTA - The HIVE Update now live on Steam
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

So happy to be sharing the first VINDICTA update since its Early Access Launch! This update includes a host of new content, bug fixes and some fine-tuning in between! It also includes a drop in price to $14.99.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/2a8c31be2f4d7f7f7714641c24e95db1b72aded0.jpg[/img]

When we initially priced VINDICTA at Early Access, we did so with the final full version in mind which included an Oculus version, more levels, multiplayer, co-op, more weapons, enemies, puzzles and more polish among other things. We wanted to launch it in Early Access so that we may build it alongside the VR community – however, that kind of accessibility proved to be a challenge at the price point we had set. 

After some back and forth with the team and many of you early VINDICTA supporters, we have decided to drop the price for now. VINDICTA will go into full release once it has lived up to both players’ expectations and ours, at which point we will re-evaluate the price to reflect the full VINDICTA launch. 

We cannot thank you enough for all the support you have shown VINDICTA so far and cannot wait to hear what you think of our latest update! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/2229a82fa37dee855c57c219839fa14f9077459f.gif[/img]

Here is a quick list of what you can expect in this new version!

- Optimized performance/Bug Fixes
[list]
    [*] Re-vamped the tutorial
    [*] More polished look to the game
    [*] Fine-tuned the aiming and recoil of the Uzi, M4 and Kriss
    [*] Fine-tuned the arm swinging locomotion
    [*] Fine-tuned the ammo clip on all weapons
[/list]
- New Level! The Hive comes with 1 hr of gameplay. It includes crazy arena fights and tricky puzzles
- Optimized enemy AI - enemies will seek you out and follow you. They get harder to defeat
- New melee weapon - added for out of ammo situations!
- New collectible shield
- Added interactions with certain environment elements
- Increased number of checkpoints throughout (beyond infamous #14!)
- New puzzle elements all through the game
- New objectives in each level
- Some of the doors in VINDICTA are now locked - you must find the key!
- 12 new skins - one for each weapon (total of 12 weapon types!)
- Kasted and LAW weapon not rechargeable anymore - once used you can dispose of them
- As you progress in the game
[list]
    [*] Enemy health increases
    [*] Enemy bullets become faster
    [*] Enemy fire rate increases
    [*] Enemy movement speed increases
[/list]
- Level changes:
[list]
    [*] Extended gameplay for each level (15-30min longer)
    [*] Higher level of difficulty in each level
    [*] New enemies encountered
[/list]
- New enemy types added:
[list]
    [*] Floating alarm detector - if it detects you, it will throw a rage of electric shocks (mini boss)
    [*] Flame thrower - enemy that shows no mercy
    [*] Electrified spider - shoots electric stuns at you and then runs for cover
[/list]
- More content! 
[list]
     [*] Easter eggs can be found throughout the game
     [*] Weapons attained through Easter eggs have +2 damage over other weapons
[/list]
- Friendly scientists are not so friendly anymore! They can spit at you so you no need to feel guilty for shooting them anymore :)

Next order of business: Oculus launch date to be announced soon!
As always, feedback and comments are more than welcome as we build this game together to full release! 

Feel free to drop us your comments on the steam page or head over to our VINDICTA [url=https://discord.gg/MKWTJEM] Discord Channel	[/url] where you can chat with other players, get heads up on upcoming announcements and chat with the developers! 

Best,
Game Cooks Team

notes.title: VINDICTA PRICE DROP ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content:
We would like to officially announce that we have dropped VINDICTA's price from $29.99 to $14.99 and let you in on what led us to take this decision so soon after Early Access launch. This is ahead of the first game update which goes live this Wednesday!

When we had initially priced VINDICTA at $29.99, we had done so with the planned game updates in mind, leading up to the final full release version - which will include frequently added new levels, new enemy types and weapons, new puzzles, hours and hours of fun gameplay, Oculus version, multiplayer and Co-Op mode!

We decided early on to launch our game in Early Access because we want to build it alongside the VR community; taking in the feedback and comments to develop and shape VINDICTA into the great game we envision it to be! Being in Early Access means making sure that the game is accessible to as many players as possible so that they can play the game and have an active role in helping us push it into full release!

That kind of accessibility we are looking for starts with the price and after some back and forth with the team and many of you early VINDICTA supporters, we have decided to drop the price to $14.99 for now. VINDICTA will go into full release once it has lived up to both players' expectations and ours and we will re-price the game to reflect the full launch!

We cannot thank you enough for all the support you have shown VINDICTA, be it right here on the steam community, SteamVR facebook group, reddit channels, Discord etc... As always, keep the feedback coming and we look forward to showing you what we have in store!

If you would like to discuss this further with the developers or any other VINDICTA related topic or even just to talk about the weather, make sure to jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/MKWTJEM] Discord Channel!	[/url]

All the best,
Game Cooks Team

notes.title: VINDICTA EA ROADMAP & NEXT UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/553ad79a643a84a036a648ccfd2bb61befdfa146.jpg[/img]


Hey Guys, 

VINDICTA has been live in Early Access for just over three weeks now and we would like to thank everyone for all the feedback and support we’ve received so far. We’ve gathered all the early access comments and reviews – they’ve really helped us push the production of the game further! As promised, we will be continuously pushing more updates with more fixes, gameplay time and more modes!

Here are the details of our current VINDICTA update – keep in mind that based on feedback we receive we might make some modifications and we’ll make sure to keep you posted on that!

[h1]VINDICTA EA V 1.2 (End of July)[/h1]

[*] Optimized performance/Bug fixes
[*] Added interactions with certain environment elements
[*] Increased number of checkpoints beyond infamous Checkpoint 14
[*] New puzzle elements throughout entire game
[*] New melee weapon added for out-of-ammo situations
[*] Optimized enemy AI - enemies seek you out and get harder to defeat
[*] More content! One new hardcore level with close to 2 hrs. of gameplay
[*] New objectives
[*] Easter Eggs throughout the game
[*] Friendly scientists are not so friendly anymore


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/2229a82fa37dee855c57c219839fa14f9077459f.gif[/img]

As you progress in the game:
[*] Enemy health increases
[*] Enemy bullets become faster
[*] Enemy fire rate increases
[*] Enemy movement speed increases

Level Changes:
[*] Extended gameplay to most levels
[*] Higher level of difficulty
[*] New enemies encounters

New enemy types:
[*] Floating Alarm Detector - if it detects you, it'll throw a range of electric shocks
[*] Flame thrower - enemy that shows no mercy
[*] Electrified spider - that shoots electric stuns at you and run to cover


[h1]VINDICTA EA V 1.3:[/h1]
[*] Oculus Rift version
[*] Fine tuning/Bug fixes

[h1]VINDICTA EA V 1.4:[/h1]
[*] Multiplayer/Co-Op
[*] New level
[*] New content

We'll update you as we add more details on Game Update 1.3 and beyond. We will keep you posted as well on any changes to the above roadmap and look forward to feeding back your comments and suggestions into the game as we build VINDICTA together!

Best,
Game Cooks Team

    [*]Download the scientist image here [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/3adqssfcgixj6mb/the%20scientist.jpg?dl=0] Here	[/url]
    [*]Caption the image with your chosen name
    [*]Share it on social media with the hashtag #vindictavr
[/list]

We will select 3 winners end of next week, each will win a $20 Steam Card!
Enjoy and can't wait to see what you guys come up with!

Example below :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/8a32a487c79b53f35d9040132fd8a920d27f384d.png[/img]

notes.title: VINDICTA ALPHA TESTERS SUBMISSION (HTC VIVE)
notes.content:
Greetings VR gamers!

From the start, we have strongly believed that the VR community, made-up of players and devs, is a crucial component to any development journey in VR and the same stands true on our way to building the awesome game we envision VINDICTA to be. That's one of the main reasons why we chose early on to release in Early Access.

And so, we're really excited to announce that we're opening up our first VINDICTA tester submission! Selected testers will get a chance to play the latest game build and help us put the finishing touches ahead of its EA launch this coming June. LET'S DO THIS!

Check out the steam page for more information on VINDICTA. To be considered, please fill out the Submission Form found here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1nyaWa4h6zPLzosGWfMah7VqPawZheMt8uPM7ni7Pffk/viewform?edit_requested=true

We will reach out mid next week to testers who have been chosen and will send along some more information about the game! In the meantime, if you have any questions, make sure to reach out to us in the comment section below!

Have a nice weekend!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28351347/9d31b85f33840e537b1b1621ecba33f4f0ca3289.png[/img]
